verdict.rationale: File transfer is a fair question for a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad remote screen app, but the evidence documents no way to send files between the Mac and the device during a session. The closest feature is two-way clipboard sync of copied text (sill-gh-4), an adjacent capability that is not file transfer. The 'the way AirDrop does' line describes how devices connect without shared Wi-Fi, not moving files.

support.subject: As a power user, I can transfer files between the host and the viewing device inside a session
